The status message slot is an empty

with no role recorded in dom-1440.json; results of 'Create draft project' and 'Export' are written there visually.
findings.after: , and write failures with role="alert"

findings.title: Controls have accessible names

findings.evidence: Busy and disabled states are shown only with opacity: 0.5 on a #1d4ed8 button with white text; this halves text contrast and the busy state has no text or aria-busy/aria-disabled change.
findings.after: Keep text contrast >= 4.5:1, change the label ('Creating...') and set aria-busy="true" or aria-disabled="true" on the button
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.1 Use of Color and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: state carried by appearance alone is not exposed.
findings.title: Text contrast on real pixels
findings.fix: Darken text or lighten ground; never thin weights on tinted ground.

findings.where: top of page, div.plans above h2 'Your projects'
findings.evidence: A page titled 'Projects' leads with a three-tier pricing row ('$9 / month', '$29 / month', '$99 / month') before the user's own projects. Failed T-MIRROR: the stock three-tier pricing block would be dropped into any SaaS screen the same way.
findings.after: Lead with the project list and its create action; move plan choice to billing or a single upgrade line tied to a real limit [DATA NEEDED: which plan limit the user is hitting]
findings.why: Each screen gets one job; a pricing upsell above the work list is the stock 'three pricing tiers' section used as filler.
findings.title: Declare one content type per page/document and give each page one job (tutorial, how-to, r

findings.evidence: heading jumps from h1 to h3
findings.title: Headings and landmarks
findings.fix: Fix levels in markup and size with CSS.

findings.title: Clear type hierarchy
findings.fix: Adopt a scale (1.25 to 1.5) and assign roles to steps.
also: whole screen, 1440 and 375: buttons 'Choose Starter', 'Choose Team', 'Choose Scale', 'Create draft project', 'Export'

findings.evidence: display text at 42px set in Inter, a UI text face
findings.title: No UI text faces as display type
findings.fix: Pick a display face for the brief; see substitutes in data/lexicons/fonts.yaml.

findings.title: Spacing has rhythm
findings.fix: Tighten within groups, open between groups.

findings.evidence: Three identical cards (same radius 20px, #f4f4f6 fill, 1px border, name/price/button) with no feature, limit or difference stated; deleting the cards' shells loses nothing (T-DELETION). The plans cannot be compared: nothing says what $29 buys over $9.
findings.before: Starter / $9 / month / Choose Starter (x3 with names swapped)
findings.after: State the one difference that sets each plan apart [DATA NEEDED: seat or project limits per plan], or render as a compact comparison row
findings.why: Equal cards with only the label swapped are a card kit, not a decision aid.
findings.title: No uniform card kit
findings.fix: Remove boxes where whitespace groups; keep one card style for things that are objects.

findings.evidence: Action colour #1d4ed8 is Tailwind blue-700 used as the only accent; the sweep's stock_swatches did not flag it.
findings.after: A product-owned accent [DATA NEEDED: brand colour], kept at >= 4.5:1 with white text
findings.why: A framework swatch as the brand accent is a default nobody chose.
findings.title: No stock framework swatches as brand tokens
findings.fix: Derive tokens from the brand source; tint neutrals toward the brand hue.
